g.text: NOW BOARDING ▸ MEANWHILE — A Claude Code mod: learn one thing a day while Claude works ✦ NOW BOARDING ▸ WAR-ROOM-OS — Release command centre for humans and AI agents: shared project context, expert review, monitoring that opens war rooms. Agents propose, people approve. ✦ NOW BOARDING ▸ SPONSIO — Contract testing and safety auditing for the WebMCP tools your site exposes to AI agents. ✦ NOW BOARDING ▸ AGENTPIXEL — See what AI agents do on your site, in the analytics you already use. Sends WebMCP tool calls, journeys, failures and conversions to GA4, GTM, PostHog or Segment in one line. Zero dependencies.
